summary: No special situation is present. This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Haleon plc on May 18, 2026, reporting a director/PDMR shareholding transaction—specifically, the acquisition of 498 ordinary shares at £3.3105 per share via dividend reinvestment by Senior Independent Non-Executive Director Alan Stewart on May 14, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange. The filing complies with UK Market Abuse Regulation disclosure requirements. There is no M&A, tender, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special event disclosed.
